title: Client-side schema fallback and validation playbook for telemetry ingestion
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: As we evolve telemetry contracts for Console and SDK/CLI clients, we need a low-friction, observable way to migrate clients without losing fidelity or causing ingest errors. Current pipeline rollouts have produced spikes in rejected events and hidden data loss during past schema deprecations.

Goal: Provide a standardized client-side pattern and operational playbook that enables: (1) graceful client migrations (feature-detection + fallback), (2) in-flight validation that surface schema mismatches before ingestion, and (3) automated translation fallbacks on the server as a temporary bridge. The deliverable is an SDK + CLI changeset, validation harness, rollout steps, dashboards, and runbook for incident/rollback scenarios.
success_criteria: SDK and CLI report schema version and feature-detection header on all events
<1% ingest rejection rate during a staged client rollout on canary users
Automated validation tests detect contract mismatches before 90% of customer impact windows
Runbook proven in a single timed drill with no customer-facing regressions
acceptance_criteria: SDK: add event metadata fields 'client_schema_version' and 'client_feature_mask' (backwards compatible)
CLI: add --telemetry-version flag and env var for overrides
Server: accept older versions and apply translation rules for deprecated fields for 30 days post-rollout
Validation harness: synthetic + sampled production replay with clear PASS/FAIL metrics
Dashboards: per-version ingest rate, reject rate, schema-diff heatmap, and alerting thresholds
proposed_solution: Client feature detection: SDK detects presence/absence of fields at runtime and emits a compact feature mask alongside a semantic schema version string
Dual-write strategy for first minor release: SDK emits both new-field and legacy-field variants (when possible) behind a flag to accelerate server-side mapping verification
In-band schema version header: add 'X-RW-Telemetry-Schema' header for CLI and SDK HTTP events to short-circuit negotiation in edge gateways
Local validation: lightweight JSON schema/shape check in SDK to fail early in dev/test and log warnings in prod without dropping events
Server-side translation layer: a temporary translator that maps vN -> vN-1 fields for 30d after rollout; tracked via metrics and cleaned up after no clients emit the older version
Canary validation: route 1-3% of traffic from updated clients to a validation cluster with strict schema rejecting to get ground truth
Telemetry staging harness: replay sampled events through the new pipeline to measure fidelity delta and surface schema diffs
Automated CI checks: contract tests that run against SDK PRs and produce a 'schema-compatibility' badge
rollout_plan: 1) Feature design review with SDK owners and PM — finalize fields and feature mask encoding (Day 0)
2) Implement client changes behind feature flag; add in-band header and local validators (Day 1-5)
3) CI contract tests + synthetic replay in staging (Day 6-8)
4) Canary release: enable on 1% of traffic and route to validation cluster (Day 9-12)
5) Monitor reject rate, schema-diff heatmap and logs for 72 hours; iterate (Day 13-15)
6) Progressive increase to 25% with dual-write enabled; run sampling replay and customer smoke tests (Day 16-20)
7) Full rollout with server-side translator in passthrough mode for 30d and scheduled cleanup (Day 21+)
Rollback criteria: sustained reject rate >0.5% above baseline or critical field loss impacting billing/alerts
test_plan: Unit tests for feature-mask encoding and header emission
Integration tests: SDK -> edge gateway -> staging ingest with vX/vX-1 translations
Contract fuzzing: generate minor variations of event shapes and ensure translator/validator behavior
Replay test: sample 48h of production events (anonymized) and run through staging translation to check fidelity metrics
Client E2E: publish canary SDK to a closed beta cohort and collect opt-in telemetry
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboards: per-client-version ingest rate, per-route reject rate, latency impact of translation, schema-diff heatmap
Alerts: Reject rate spike (P0) — threshold: 0.3% sustained over 5 minutes for canary, 0.5% for global
SLO checks: ensure latency p95 of telemetry ingest pipeline does not degrade >10ms during translation
Automated report: daily summary of clients still emitting older versions with a retention window
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Dual-write increases payload volume and cost — Mitigation: enable for smallest sample set and monitor token/storage delta
Risk: Server translator bug causing silent data corruption — Mitigation: strict QA, schema-diff alerts, and a conservative cleanup window before deletion
Risk: SDK local validation false positives in older runtimes — Mitigation: add graceful logging and opt-out env var for problematic environments
Risk: CLI users pinned to old versions missing new fields — Mitigation: document flag and provide backcompat shim in edge gateway
